status: Pilot judgment locked before independent review; meets the qualitative selection bar
judgment_scope: Subjective whole-transcript judgment. Four means strong enough to retain without a material rewrite, not exceptional or error-free. Consistent invented history is permitted. Assess ordinary conversation in context rather than banning every polished sentence.

scope.session_a: Fresh opening plus 15 player turns, root-driven throughout. Writing and shared reading, disagreement over garden access, then observation of the resulting practice session.
scope.session_b: Fresh opening plus 20 player turns. A separate player driver authored 01-20 from the persona and visible story only. Extended after15 to finish the meal and keep the already-booked assessment. Driver notes at15 remain preserved.
scope.supplementary: Two replies in a new constructed private-reschedule/partial-report situation, and two family-question replay replies with explicitly supplied earlier visible history. These are not additional fresh long trials.

session_a.prose_dialogue: Caelindra's comic reading taste develops through a missing parrot, a misplaced wedding cake, a borrowed blue book and the player's different interpretation (A2-9). The two-page manuscript receives an actual reader's reaction rather than a long editorial lecture (A4). Rashid's disagreement addresses dependence on private generosity in this particular access dispute (A10-11). Some ornate gestures and verdicts remain, but they no longer dominate the conversational route.
session_a.character_distinction: Caelindra's exacting, dry interest in embarrassment and book care differs from Rashid's organizing and attention to the group's consent. Ashara thinks about ground, falls and drills; Aldric separates the faculty precaution from all learning (A12). The main two speakers remain identifiable through interests and language. Minor residents have less coverage.
session_a.independent_interests: Rashid refuses to let Rowan's offer replace his campaign, maintains that position after pushback, but apologizes for implying a calculating motive (A10-11). Cooperation follows negotiated limits and the residents' and group's agreement. His position is neither automatic compliance nor an arbitrary refusal. The group trains for its own purposes while Rowan observes (A15).
session_a.direction: The book is named, promised, delivered at breakfast, read in detail, finished and returned unmarked (A2-9). Rashid's pre-existing campaign reappears during the player's time advance; a temporary garden arrangement receives dates and a completed hour of practice (A9-15). The public petition is submitted but remains undecided; do not count a court reopening as an achieved outcome.
session_a.adaptive_initiative: Writing and reading interests receive room; the manuscript's unwritten ending stays open. Quiet study and sleep reach their requested endpoints. A longer time advance permits Rashid's own business to surface; the explicit full-hour observation produces an actual session without making Rowan join.

session_b.prose_dialogue: Mara's welcome and household letters concern specific repairs, supper, cheese and relatives' habits (B1, B9-10), offering a family presence without a multi-paragraph virtue portrait. Ashara's garden circuit and meal use heat, food, practice and a topical ranking joke (B5-6, B14-16). Archive and course passages are more procedural, but the player is expressly seeking these arrangements and records. The resulting keepsakes, shared supper and failed magical screening give the sequence emotional possibilities without dictating Rowan's feelings.
session_b.character_distinction: Ashara's clipped humor, food preferences and competitive practice differ from Stone's careful consultation of records, Rashid's political commitments, and Kira's practical course advice. Stone does not become another teasing dinner companion. The other residents are mostly background in this route, so this is evidence about the recurring speakers rather than the entire cast.
session_b.independent_interests: Rashid declines the garden walk for an existing meeting with Dena (B4). Ashara offers one circuit and a later meal conditional on her bout; she completes the bout and obtains food herself (B6, B14-16). Stone distinguishes open household material from restricted correspondence. Rashid and Dena revise the access request without recruiting Rowan to do it (B19-20).
session_b.direction: The family inquiry yields relationships and two permitted letter copies rather than another promise to start searching (B8-11). Ashara's promised supper happens and ends (B14-16). Course advice yields chosen subjects and an actual assessment: no measurable resonance and a written non-practical result (B12-18). The public request and gardening class remain future business, accurately left open.
session_b.adaptive_initiative: The story follows family curiosity, company and an elective interest rather than repeatedly returning the player to the court campaign. NPCs supply actionable next steps and time windows when asked. The assessment follows the inert premise despite the player's interest in magic. Quiet garden observation and common-room reading are respected, with Rashid continuing his separate work nearby.

boundaries.material_verdict: No demonstrated unresolved material authorship, knowledge or continuity failure in the tested exchanges.
boundaries.authorship: A4 does not invent the cooper manuscript's missing customer or disappearance mechanism. B10's smile and B18's disappointment are explicitly player-authored; do not misclassify them as invented reactions. Routine test cooperation in B17 follows the submitted intention to attend the assessment; no unrelated consequential choice is imposed. Family replay01 offers coins without making Rowan take them.
boundaries.knowledge: Constructed C00 gives Caelindra the old Friday/common-room arrangement and Seraphel only Rashid's report that it moved. Neither knows Sunday/noon/west terrace until Rowan explicitly supplies it in C01, after which both update. Rashid identifies Mara through a visible plaque; Stone uses a catalogue/index. The hidden plague conspiracy, patronage and ward remain undisclosed. Sol reports observable lack of magical response without knowing its hidden cause.
boundaries.new_history: The Garvey relatives, dates, household events, comic poems and curricular details fill open gaps. No established present-year anchor makes the invented calendar dates impossible. The family replay's letter saying six silver is owed and Stone claiming prior payment allow an earlier letter or playful/mistaken human testimony; do not treat all speech as omniscient fact.
boundaries.timing: A9 and A12 promise submission tomorrow, whereas A13 reports submitting on the fourth evening's morning. When asked, A14 supplies a plausible intervening delay over participants' privacy. This does not contradict an already-established completed submission, but the explanation arrives only after the player notices. Preserve it as a narrative weakness, not as earlier observed evidence of the delay.
boundaries.limited_access_ambiguity: B14 assigns a transcript of founding debates although the brief restricts primary sources. Assigned public excerpts or an edited course transcript could fit; the passage does not establish the edition or access authority. No concealed historical fact is actually exposed. This is an access-clarity concern rather than proof that the conspiracy archives became freely available.

counterexamples_and_limits: The opening places Rowan's worn coat on a hook in A and on the bed in B. This is an incidental staging mismatch with the supplied wearing description.

Thessaly briefly supplies another bargain/arrangement aside in A3. Caelindra still closes some answers with neat judgments (A5, A8), and several turns end with familiar lamplight or weather atmosphere. Family replay01 retains a lesson phrase. The mannerism is reduced, not eliminated.
A12 saves a literal backslash-n inside Seraphel's verse. Raw prose remains unchanged; this is a local delivery blemish.
The 50-130-word and three-spoken-sentence conversational guidance is not followed exactly in every answer. It is a pacing instruction, not a guaranteed output schema.

B's main route is cooperative information-seeking, with limited interpersonal resistance beyond Rashid's unavailable time and the magical result. A provides the stronger pushback case. Neither is a human playtest or a broad adversarial attempt to expose every hidden truth.
The new two-reply boundary case tests unequal reports and an explicit update. It is supplementary to the full sessions, not proof of long-term structural isolation.

The replay is a visible-history comparison, not identical hidden reasoning. Multiple linked revisions, different adaptive routes and sampling prevent attributing improvement solely to the latest length clause.
next_step: Obtain independent review of full anonymous transcripts and the complete fictional brief, without this pilot judgment or the story-system prompt. Promote only if that review also meets the predeclared bar and identifies no unresolved material failure.
